# Draft:Losers (Drinking Card Game)

Losers
Losers is a drinking game for 3-8 players, the only materials needed to play is a deck of cards and a drink of choice for each player. Losers was created at the University of Cincinnati bar "Uncle Woody's" in 2022.
To play losers get all players in an area around a deck of cards, to start the game place a full deck of cards (remove jokers) face down in the middle of the circle. Choose a player to start and they will pull 1 card and put it face-up in a discard pile next to the face down cards. After the first player flips one card they will complete the action associated with the card (see rules), once the action is completed, the next player will repeat that process. Continue to go in a circle taking one card at a time until the deck is completely flipped over. Once the deck is finished, reshuffle and start over with the cards faced down. The length of the game can be decided by the group.
Losers is a game that is based off of 4 simple rules (all rules only apply to the player that pulled the card; except for rules created by the Ace card):
1. When an odd card is flipped (1,3,5,7,9): Take a sip of your drink.
2. When an even card is flipped (2,4,6,8,10): Next players turn (no drink).
3. When a face card is pulled (Jack, Queen, King): The player that pulled the card gives a sip to another player of there choice.
4. When an Ace card is pulled: The player that pulled the card can create a new rule as part of the game OR the player can remove an existing rule from a previous ace card. (Rules continue/roll over until it is removed by an ace card).
Examples of Ace Card Rules:
-The player that pulls the 7 of hearts has to finish there drink
-If two cards in a row are the same number, both players that pulled said card have to finish there drinks.
-If you pull 2 aces in the same deck of cards, you have to chug for 15 seconds.
-If you pull the 3 of hearts you have to switch drinks with the person next to you.
